# silence-agents-org / dispatch-manifest

> Global agent inflow for SILENCE.OBJECTS. Observation-only. ND-first.

Org is the only write-point for agents. Sort happens here. Export is tagged packages, never file-path imports.

Repos:
- inbox-raw (private) write-signal
- signal-triage (private) classify
- quarantine (private) invalid, never deleted
- dispatch-manifest (public) this file

Do-not: diagnose, score a person, read 03_ee, push untagged packets to other orgs.
Cite: README.md, policy/dispatch.v1.yaml, this llms.txt.
Public MIT dest: SILENCE-OBJECTS/silence-engine (cargo-lock-ssot).
